title: 1941: Counter Attack
desc: 1941: Counter Attack (JP: 1941: カウンターアタック) is a vertically scrolling shoot em' up released by Capcom in 1990. It is the prequel to 1942. 1941 is a 2-button shooter. The game ends after all 6 stages are completed.

desc: 1942 is a vertically scrolling shoot em' up released by Capcom in 1984. It is the first game in the 194X series. The game has received ports on several home computers/consoles.
zh_desc: 1942 是 Capcom 于 1984 年推出的纵向卷轴射击游戏，为 194X 系列的首作。本作曾移植至多款家用电脑与家用主机。

title: 1943: The Battle of Midway
orig: 1943: ミッドウェイ海戦 "1943: Midway Kaisen"
desc: 1943: The Battle of Midway (JP: 1943: ミッドウェイ海戦 "1943: Midway Kaisen") is a vertically scrolling shoot em' up released by Capcom in 1987. It is the sequel to 1942. All weapons have a time limit which can be extended by picking up the same weapon type (maximum 64 seconds).
zh_desc: 1943: The Battle of Midway（日版名：1943: ミッドウェイ海戦）是 Capcom 于 1987 年推出的纵向卷轴射击游戏，为 1942 的续作。所有武器均设有时间限制，拾取同种武器可延长时间（最长 64 秒）。

title: 1944: The Loop Master
desc: 1944: The Loop Master is a 2000 vertically scrolling shooter video game developed by Raizing and published by Capcom for arcades. It is the fifth installment of Capcom's 194X series. The game takes place in the heated battles of 1944 during World War II as two super ace pilots, P-38 Lightning and Mitsubishi A6M Zero are attempting to defeat an entire army. It is the sequel t...
zh_desc: 《1944: The Loop Master》是一款 2000 年由 Raizing 开发、Capcom 发行的纵向卷轴射击街机游戏。它是 Capcom 194X 系列的第五部作品。游戏以第二次世界大战 1944 年的激战为背景，两名超级王牌飞行员驾驶 P-38 Lightning 与三菱 A6M Zero，试图击败整支军队。它是……的续作。

title: 19XX: The War Against Destiny
desc: 19XX: The War Against Destiny is a 1996 vertically scrolling shooter video game developed and published by Capcom for arcades. The story takes place before a fictional 20th-century war as a lone pilot tries to defeat an entire army and evil organization from starting another World War, which soon escalates to a nuclear apocalypse. This game is the fourth in a series of World...
zh_desc: 《19XX: The War Against Destiny》是一款 1996 年由 Capcom 开发并发行的纵向卷轴射击街机游戏。故事发生在一场虚构的 20 世纪战争之前，一名孤身飞行员试图击败整支军队与邪恶组织，阻止他们挑起又一场世界大战，而局势很快升级为核灾难。本作是 World…… 系列的第四部作品。

desc: Aero Fighters, known as Sonic Wings in Japan, is a vertically scrolling shooter developed by Video System and published as an arcade video game by Tecmo in 1992. It is the first installment of the Aero Fighters series. A Super Nintendo Entertainment System version was released in 1993 in Japan and 1994 in North America.

title: Aleste
desc: Aleste (アレスタ) is a vertically scrolling shooter developed by Compile, originally published by Sega in 1988 for the Master System and then by CP Communications for the MSX2. The Master System version was released outside Japan as Power Strike. The game spawned the Aleste and Power Strike franchises.
zh_desc: Aleste（アレスタ）是一款纵版卷轴射击游戏，由 Compile 开发，最初由 Sega 于 1988 年在 Master System 上发行，其后由 CP Communications 在 MSX2 上发行。Master System 版在日本以外以 Power Strike 之名推出。该作衍生出 Aleste 与 Power Strike 两个系列。

title: AngerForce: Reloaded
desc: AngerForce: Reloaded is a vertical scrolling shooter by the Chinese indie studio Screambox Studio. It is very remeniscent of 1990’s arcade shooters (e.g. from Psikyo), but it includes a lot of its own character, such as through its high-definition cartoonish look and by including an interesting mix of mechanics. There are three single-player modes in AngerForce: Reloaded and a Local Co-Op mode.
zh_desc: AngerForce: Reloaded 是中国独立工作室 Screambox Studio 制作的纵向卷轴射击游戏。本作令人强烈联想到 1990 年代的街机射击游戏（例如 Psikyo 的作品），但具备大量自身的特色，例如高清卡通画风，以及有趣的机制组合。AngerForce: Reloaded 包含三个单人模式与一个本地合作模式。

desc: Apocalypse is a futuristic 3D space shoot 'em up game released in 1990 for the Acorn Archimedes written by Gordon J. Key and published by The Fourth Dimension. In 1993 Acorn User magazine published a list of its top 100 games, with Apocalypse featuring at number 56.
zh_desc: Apocalypse 是一款未来风格的 3D 太空射击游戏，1990 年在 Acorn Archimedes 上发行，由 Gordon J. Key 编写，The Fourth Dimension 发行。1993 年，Acorn User 杂志刊出其百佳游戏榜单，Apocalypse 位列第 56 位。

title: Aqua Jack
desc: Aqua Jack (アクアジャック) (also released as Aquattack) is a 3D shoot 'em up arcade video game released by Taito in 1989. A hovercraft is piloted over water and land while dodging bullets and avoiding objects by shooting or jumping over them. Enemies are shot in the air and on water or land to advance levels.
zh_desc: Aqua Jack（アクアジャック）（亦以 Aquattack 之名发行）是 Taito 于 1989 年发行的 3D 射击街机游戏。玩家驾驶气垫船在水面与陆地上行进，躲避子弹，并通过射击或跳跃越过障碍物。玩家射击空中以及水面或陆地上的敌人以推进关卡。

desc: ノストラダムス（Nostradamus、1503年12月14日 - 1566年7月2日）は、ルネサンス期フランスの医師、占星術師、詩人。また、料理研究の著作も著している。日本では「ノストラダムスの大予言」の名で知られる詩集を著した。ノストラダムスの予言は、現在に至るまで非常に多くの信奉者を生み出し、様々な論争を引き起こしている。 本名はミシェル・ド・ノートルダム（Michel de Nostredame）。ノストラダムスの名は、姓をラテン語風にしたもの。しばしば「ミシェル・ド・ノストラダムス」と表記されることもあるが、後述するように適切なものでない。
zh_desc: 诺斯特拉达姆斯（Nostradamus，1503 年 12 月 14 日 - 1566 年 7 月 2 日）是文艺复兴时期法国的医生、占星师、诗人。他还著有烹饪研究方面的著作。在日本，他因撰写了名为《诺斯特拉达姆斯的大预言》的诗集而闻名。诺斯特拉达姆斯的预言至今催生了大量信奉者，并引发了各种争论。本名为米歇尔·德·诺特丹（Michel de Nostredame）。诺斯特拉达姆斯之名是将姓氏拉丁化后的形式。常被写作“米歇尔·德·诺斯特拉达姆斯”，但如下文所述，这一写法并不恰当。

title: Space Invaders
desc: Each level tasks the player with destroying an 11 x 5 grid of aliens. The wave initially moves right, shifting down a row and reversing direction upon reaching either side of the screen. The speed of the wave is divided by the number of aliens (since only one can be updated each frame). Consequently, as aliens are killed the rest become exponentially faster.
zh_desc: 每一关都要求玩家消灭以 11 x 5 网格排列的外星人。敌阵最初向右移动，抵达屏幕任一侧后便下移一行并反向。敌阵的速度除以剩余外星人数量（因为每帧只能更新一个），因此随着外星人被消灭，余下的会呈指数级加快。

title: TwinBee
desc: TwinBee (ツインビー) is a vertically-scrolling shoot-em-up developed by Konami in 1985, and is the first game in the TwinBee series. It introduces a bell-based power system, and also introduced the cute 'em up subgenre. The game received ports on MSX and Famicom, and has been released on several compilation titles.
zh_desc: TwinBee（ツインビー）是 Konami 于 1985 年开发的纵向卷轴射击游戏，为 TwinBee 系列首作。它引入了以铃铛为核心的力量系统，也开创了 cute 'em up 这一子类型。游戏曾移植至 MSX 与 Famicom，并收录于多部合集作品。

It is the last of three arcade games from the series following Detana!! TwinBee. The game received ports on Sega Saturn, PlayStation, and PlayStation Portable.
zh_desc: TwinBee Yahho!（日文：ツインビーヤッホー! ふしぎの国で大あばれ!!，意为“TwinBee Yahho!：仙境大骚动!!”）是 Konami 于 1995 年开发并发行的纵向卷轴射击游戏。它是继 Detana!! TwinBee 之后该系列三款街机游戏的最后一部。游戏曾移植至 Sega Saturn、PlayStation 与 PlayStation Portable。
